mapper.sql: select id, product_seq, product_name, num, remark, created_by, created_date, last_upd_by, last_upd_date from micro_finished_product_storage
mapper.insert:
insert into micro_finished_product_storage
product_seq, product_name, num, remark, created_by, created_date, last_upd_by, last_upd_date,
#{productSeq}, #{productName}, #{num}, #{remark}, #{createdBy}, #{createdDate}, #{lastUpdBy}, #{lastUpdDate},

insert into micro_finished_product_storage( product_seq, product_name, num, remark, created_by, created_date, last_upd_by, last_upd_date ) values
( #{item.productSeq}, #{item.productName}, #{item.num}, #{item.remark}, #{item.createdBy}, now(), null, null )

update.foreach:
UPDATE micro_finished_product_storage
product_seq = #{item.productSeq},
product_name = #{item.productName},
num = #{item.num},
remark = #{item.remark},
last_upd_by = #{item.lastUpdBy},
last_upd_date = #{item.lastUpdDate},
where id = #{item.id}

mapper.select: SELECT mfps.* FROM micro_finished_product_storage mfps INNER JOIN micro_product mp on mfps.product_seq = mp.product_seq WHERE (mfps.num < 0 OR (mfps.num > 0 AND mfps.num < mp.stock_lower_limit) OR mfps.num > mp.stock_upper_limit)

select mp.product_code as productCode, mp.product_name as productName, mfps.product_seq as productSeq, mp.stock_lower_limit as stockLowerLimit, mp.stock_upper_limit as stockUpperLimit, mfps.num as stockNum, CAST(mp.product_name as char character set gbk) as sortName from micro_finished_product_storage mfps INNER JOIN micro_product mp on mfps.product_seq = mp.product_seq
(mfps.num < 0 or (mfps.num >0 and mfps.num < mp.stock_lower_limit) or mfps.num > mp.stock_upper_limit)
and (mp.product_code like concat('%', #{productNameOrCode}, '%') or mp.product_name like concat('%', #{productNameOrCode}, '%'))
and mfps.num < 0
and mfps.num >0 and mfps.num < mp.stock_lower_limit
and mfps.num > mp.stock_upper_limit
order by sortName

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN mfps.num < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) as negativeStockFlagNum, SUM(CASE WHEN mfps.num > 0 and mfps.num < mp.stock_lower_limit THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) as lowerSafetyStockFlagNum, SUM(CASE WHEN mfps.num > mp.stock_upper_limit THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) as upperSafetyStockFlagNum FROM micro_finished_product_storage mfps INNER JOIN micro_product mp ON mfps.product_seq = mp.product_seq
and (mp.product_code like concat('%', #{productNameOrCode}, '%') or mp.product_name like concat('%', #{productNameOrCode}, '%'))

SELECT mp.id as itemId, mp.product_seq as itemSeq, mp.product_code as itemCode, mp.product_name as itemName FROM micro_finished_product_storage mfps INNER JOIN micro_product mp ON mfps.tenant_code = mp.tenant_code AND mfps.product_seq = mp.product_seq WHERE mp.id in
#{id}
